answers.genPolicy:271dea8c5aeb8e035dce4c1a3c0169:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .

[B2] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .

[B3] < deviceB | ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | ... > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | FreshSecret .

[B3] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ... > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | Secret
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , CurrentTime) , Tickets) , ...) , ... > .

[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , CurrentTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA | deviceB
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , CurrentTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (deviceB ; Secret) .

[B4] < UserX | 'knows' : Knowledge , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (deviceB ; Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knows' : (Secret , Knowledge) , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : nils , 'tickets' : ((Secret , IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX) , 'tickets' : ((Secret , IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ... > .

[B6] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (UserOwner , RestOwners) , 'tickets' : ((Secret , IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , UserOwner , RestOwners) , 'tickets' : ((Secret , IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ... > .

[B7] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : ((Secret , IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : nils , ...) , ... > if CurrentTime - IssuedTime > 2 .
